text: Meet Shadow: your Odoo, in your employees' hands.
It works with the Odoo you already run: versions fifteen to nineteen, no module to install.
Six everyday apps, one place: time off, expenses, attendance, timesheets, helpdesk and maintenance.
Here's an example. An employee requests time off.
It lands in Odoo as a real record, and the manager approves it there.
The employee gets the answer, right on their phone.
Shadow, by Octagon9. Your Odoo, in every pocket.
